measures.label: Undergraduates awarded grants/scholarships
measures.definition: Grant/scholarship aid from all known sources for the SFA all-undergraduate cohort, not any aid including loans and not only entering first-time students. Aid reporting period ends in the collection start year (SFA2324 in the 2024–25 release refers to 2023–24). Term reporters use a fall cohort; program reporters use a full-year cohort, so populations differ across calendar systems. 2023 documentation has an SFA table-location correction; source definitions are preserved. This mapping has not been compared with a user-supplied longitudinal aid benchmark.
